templates.title: Omnia Forza HDS (host)
templates.description: Omnia Forza HDS audio processor with `host` networking

env.name: TAG
env.label: Software version tag
env.description: OPTIONAL. Leave blank to use the default (latest). Version of software.

env.name: INSTANCE_NAME
env.label: Container name
env.description: REQUIRED. Set the container name, hostname and studio (if applicable).

env.name: HTTP_PORT
env.label: Web Interface TCP Port
env.description: OPTIONAL. Leave blank to use the default (80). TCP Port used to run the web server that serves the GUI and API.

env.name: IFACE_AOIP
env.label: AoIP network interface
env.description: REQUIRED. Network interface for AoIP traffic, including clock synchronization where used. (eg: eth0, eno1, enp1s0)

env.name: EX_CLOCK_SOURCE
env.label: Audio timebase source
env.description: OPTIONAL. Leave blank to use the default (ptp-snooping). Options: [ptp-snooping] Software PTP. Recommended in most cases | [clock-tai] OS TAI time | [/dev/ptp0] PTP hardware timestamp device.

env.name: EX_AOIP_CLOCK
env.label: AoIP Clock Type
env.description: OPTIONAL. Leave blank to use the default (0). Applies to ptp-snooping only, type of clock packets to receive: [0] PTP | [1] Livewire.

env.name: EX_PTP_DOMAIN
env.label: PTP domain number
env.description: OPTIONAL. Leave blank to use the default (0). Set the PTP domain number. Applies to ptp-snooping with PTP clock only.

env.name: EX_AOIP_TASK_RATE
env.label: Task Execution
env.description: OPTIONAL. Leave blank to use the default (1000). Set the rate at which AoIP packets are sent. This not packet length. It is how frequently packets are sent.

env.name: EX_RT_CPU
env.label: Realtime Reserved CPU
env.description: OPTIONAL. Leave blank to allow tasks on all CPUs. CPU number (using OS numbering) on which the container will always run realtime tasks and never run non-realtime tasks.
